purpose: Freeze the 2026-08-10/11 upgrade sweep at the point where additional public discovery has sharply diminishing evidential return. Preserve exact-source residuals without converting them into a new open-ended search programme.
principles: A case is promoted for an evidential mechanism, not for geographic coverage or collection size.
S at architecture or collection level does not imply item-level transaction closure.
Historical numbering, catalogue addresses, museum accessions, slide numbers, cabinet positions and modern digital IDs remain separate namespaces unless a source explicitly links them.
Resume a parked case only when a bounded source can change attribution, chronology, object identity, custody or mechanism.

stop_rule: No further broad public-web or geographic sweep. New research resumes only from an exact source arrival, a user-supplied object/image, or a newly bounded identifier. Default next phase is synthesis, argument construction and writing.

interpretive_payoff.core_historical_claim: Microscope preparations were stabilized as knowledge objects by systems of addresses, catalogues, cabinets, labels, series, registers and maintenance practices. Those systems could survive, translate or repair material discontinuity, and they often preserve a richer operational history than the glass object alone.
